symptoms: Floral organs and grain spikelets replaced by brown-black powdery masses of teliospores
Fragile outer silver-gray membrane ruptured exposing loose fungal spores
Severe deformation and sterility of infected wheat spikelets
Premature emergence of diseased blackened ears compared to healthy crop
qualityPredictions.treatmentRecommendation: Perform seed treatment before sowing with Carboxin 75 WP (Vitavax) @ 2.0-2.5 g/kg seed or Tebuconazole 2 DS @ 1.25 g/kg seed as per ICAR guidelines. Practice solar heat seed treatment during May-June (soak seeds in water for 4 hours, then dry in hot sun). Carefully collect and destroy infected ears in polythene bags to prevent air-borne spore spread to flowering spikes.
defectNotes: Severe systemic fungal infection (Loose Smut)
Destruction of edible grain tissues
High spore load contaminating standing crop
qualityPredictions.priceRationale: Grade C (Loose Smut of Wheat (Ustilago tritici)): Identified 45% surface pathology/decay. Discounted valuation of ₹21.8/kg (₹2180/Qtl) recommended for fast industrial pulping or immediate discount liquidation.
